priority_outcomes: Stabilize or increase active user count
non_negotiables: Must use email as the primary communication channel
Must address the decline in feature adoption
Must not ignore the open support case sentiment
success_signals: Resolution of open support case with positive sentiment

design_thesis: The 'Signal Garden' concept moves away from a corrective dashboard toward a spatial, reflective experience. Instead of presenting data as a failure, we present it as a landscape of activity. Users navigate through 'SignalStrands' that visualize the current state of their ecosystem. By acknowledging the friction of the open support case as a known element in the landscape, we build trust through transparency rather than ignoring the elephant in the room.

experience_principles.name: Transparency of State
experience_principles.rationale: Users must understand exactly why they are seeing this view and what the data represents.

experience_principles.name: Dignified Exit
experience_principles.rationale: Recovery should never feel like a trap; users must be able to leave the experience at any time.

experience_principles.name: Empathetic Friction Management
experience_principles.rationale: Acknowledge existing support issues to validate user experience without overstepping.

recovery_concept.name: Signal Garden
recovery_concept.one_line_promise: A reflective space to view your ecosystem's health and choose your next step.
recovery_concept.entry_state: LoadingState transitioning to ReadyState with SignalCanvas.
recovery_concept.core_moment: The moment the user inspects a SignalStrand and is presented with an optional path to clarify their needs.
recovery_concept.exit_state: SuccessState (if path chosen) or DeclinedState (if exit chosen).

journey.title: Arrival
journey.customer_goal: Understand why I was sent this link.
journey.system_response: Displaying the current state of your Copper Finch ecosystem.

journey.customer_goal: See the specific trends in my account.

journey.system_response: Select a path to re-engage or provide feedback.
journey.consent_check: Explicit choice of recovery path or exit.

content_architecture.label: Signal Overview

content_architecture.label: Friction Acknowledgment
content_architecture.purpose: Acknowledge the open support case without speculation

content_architecture.label: Recovery Options

permission_moments.customer_control: Optional selection of a recovery path
Optional clarification of feature usage needs

additional_safety_patterns: Explicit exit path that does not persist state
No forced continuity or subscription traps

keyboard: Sequential tab order through all interactive signal strands
Visible focus indicators for all clickable elements
Logical tab flow for the exit path
screen_reader: Aria-live regions for state changes (loading, success, error)
Descriptive labels for all signal strands
Semantic heading structure for the recovery room
visual: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text
No reliance on color alone to convey signal direction
Clear visual distinction between active and inactive states
reduced_motion: Use instant state changes for all component transitions
No parallax or ambient motion effects

motion_language.intent: Motion must communicate causality and state, not decorate or obstruct.
motion_language.reduced_motion_fallback: Instant state changes with no transitions.

measurement_plan.guardrail: Ensure adoption increase is not driven by trial period expiration.

measurement_plan.interpretation: Indicates successful return of dormant users.
measurement_plan.guardrail: Monitor for artificial spikes from single-session users.

measurement_plan.signal: Resolution of open support case with positive sentiment
measurement_plan.source_success_signal: Resolution of open support case with positive sentiment
measurement_plan.guardrail: Ensure resolution is verified by user sentiment, not just case closure.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: User feels monitored due to granular signal display.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use aggregate signals only; never show individual user events.
risks_and_mitigations.escalation_trigger: High bounce rate from the Recovery Room.

risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Acknowledge the case as a known item without making promises.

build_order: Implement core SignalCanvas and SignalStrand components.
Implement state management for Loading, Ready, and Active states.
Apply accessibility and reduced motion overrides.

data_bindings.display_purpose: Show the percentage of feature adoption.
Show the current active user count.
Acknowledge the existence of an open case.

acceptance_tests: Verify SignalStrand correctly binds to aggregate metrics.
Ensure ClarificationModal is dismissible via Escape key.
Confirm ReducedMotionState removes all CSS transitions.
Validate that no new features are named or created in the UI.
